title: BondBERT: What We Learn when Assigning Sentiment in the Bond Market

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3: 'Sentiment labels were generated using GPT-4.1-nano via the OpenAI API'; footnote 7: 'We evaluated different GPT models, such as GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1-mini ... opted for GPT-4.1-nano'

prompt.location: Labelling prompt described in Sec. 3 (bond-price impact framing); twelve sanity-check snippets

claim.metric: none: GPT-4.1-nano only supplies training labels for BondBERT; results are BondBERT event-study metrics

data.source: proprietary financial news article corpus (not released); 12 hand-written snippets

notes: Live model is the annotator for a fine-tuned BERT; no metric of the annotator itself against human labels is reported.
